title: Admins can toggle the main UI features (Dashboards, Apps, Notebooks, MDX workbench, SQL workbench) per role, users see only what they are granted, denied callers are refused even with a direct link, and every change is audited

criteria.given: two authenticated callers with different roles on a default install
criteria.then: the server resolves feature visibility per caller (ROLE_ADMIN always passes; a restricted feature is visible only to the roles it lists) and the session surface exposes the caller's own effective feature map

criteria.given: an admin in the admin panel
criteria.then: GET /rest/saiku/admin/features returns the feature catalogue with the current per-role grants, and PUT /rest/saiku/admin/features rewrites them; the admin surface itself is never feature-gated

criteria.given: an admin changes a feature's role grants
criteria.then: the change is recorded in the feature-toggle audit trail served at GET /rest/saiku/admin/features/audit with the actor, feature, and before/after grants

criteria.given: a caller denied a feature follows a direct link
criteria.then: the backing REST surface refuses the request (403 for an authenticated non-granted caller), so the denial does not depend on the SPA hiding the nav entry
